lines.en: The bottles on my back clink as I walk.
Careful now, my potions will spill.
I walk the lava edge to warm my feet.
There is a shortcut under the crimson stems.
This flask needs two more shakes on the way.
Wart powder itches under my feet.
A bitter smell drifts from the far village.
I walk slower so the bubbles settle.
Gold ingots clink against my hip.
This path smells faintly sweet to me.
I count the steps down to my brewing stand.
Move aside, I carry a warm flask.
I have recited the recipe a hundred times.
This brew's color is still slightly off.
Bitter? Then it finally worked.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子闻得出烈焰粉。
lines.en: My snout can smell blaze powder.
Do not add too many fermented spider eyes.
Three washes, and the bottle stays cloudy.
The lava bubbles beneath my bench.
I lick the potion I just splashed.
My snout stings; that means sulfur.
A pinch of sugar rounds out the taste.
You are standing in front of my jars.
Buying? Show your gold first.
Keep your hands off the green flask.
You smell of gunpowder to me.
I have no antidote for what ails you.
Want a sip? It will be bitter.
Stand still and let my snout check you.
Your shadow blocks my brewing fire.
Put down gold and take the flask.
You look thirsty, very thirsty indeed.
Not the face; my snout matters.
That blow loosened a tusk.
I took that hit holding my jar.
The smell of blood mixed with brew.
It hurts, but my hands stay steady.
You knocked over half a cauldron.
One more tear in my apron.
Stop; I still have brewing to do.
That one landed on my shoulder blade.
I step back, shielding the bench.
Gold? Hand it over for a potion.
That pinch of blaze powder belongs to me.
Is that nether wart in your hand?
Sugar... I take only a tiny pinch.
The smell of gold tickles my snout.
That cloudy bottle, I know it well.
Do not shake it; the sediment scatters.
Two flasks for one piece of your gold.
Magma cream? That one I will take.
I smell it, sweet and fermented.
My bottles! Did you crack them?
You stepped in my brewing waste.
Step back; do not touch the hot one.
That bump scattered all my wart powder.
Your armor hit my snout.
There is still slime on my hands.
Easy now, do not tip my bench.
My apron is covered in stains.
Steady there; piglin legs are short.
You have my potion on you now.
A family? First save enough gold.

lines.zh: 我的伴儿嫌我一身苦味。
lines.en: My mate says I always taste bitter.
Two brewing stands, side by side.
We would share each new recipe.
She likes the smell of sulfur too.
The little one must keep off my flame.
Nobody in this village will marry me.
Even wed, I would still brew.
I have laid aside a jar of sweet wine.
Where my mate is, my bench follows.
Whose flask is this? Still usable.
Gold nuggets! Just what I lacked.
A fermented spider eye lies here.
I lift it and wipe the dust away.
Empty; what a waste of glass.
This stem piece will feed my fire.
My fingers stick to it; put it down.
Who crumpled up this recipe page?
A blackstone block to steady my bench.
Picking up gold is an old piglin habit.
A stranger has entered the village.
He is walking toward my jars.
Protect the brewing stand first.
Those steps are not a villager's.
You have raised that thing of yours.
The guard is away; I will hold.
Who is touching my supply chest?
He is the one who tipped that flask.
An unfamiliar smell entered the pig village.
My snout keeps pointing at him.
He trampled the shroomlight sprouts.

lines.zh: 别以为酿造师不会打架。
lines.en: Do not think brewers cannot fight.
I grab the nearest bottle.
The village alarm has not sounded yet.
I follow you around the lava pool.
Do not run into the brewing district.
You take a step; I take one.
My snout has memorized you.
I saw your hand on that hilt.
This alley offers just one exit.

lines.zh: 我把瓶子换成硬的那只。
lines.en: I swap my flask for a hard one.
You press to the wall; suits me fine.
One grunt from me closes doors.
Do not hide behind the crimson stem.
Your steps crunch far too loudly.
I stand in front of the supply chest.
Eye contact means no innocent face.
That bitter smell stays on my hands.
The bottle breaks on your shoulder.
My fist is coated in brewing residue.
Just one tap with the flat of my axe.
Do not make me swing the hot kettle.
Your armor left a white scratch on me.
A kick lands on your knee.
I have your bracer in my grip.
That one should push you back three steps.
The potion splashed all over you.
A piglin snout hits hard too.
I still grip half a broken neck.
Mid-fight, I think of brewing again.
Hold still; my aim is only fair.
After this, pay me for the glass.
I lit my burner before dawn.

lines.zh: 我从菌光体那边走过来。
lines.en: I came over from the shroomlight grove.
A new batch, a new day.
The village is short of potions today.
I set my stall in the usual spot.

lines.zh: 鼻子里全是下界的硫味。
lines.en: My snout is full of Nether sulfur.
I set up my burner by the lava.
The pig village walls leak wind again.

lines.zh: 有人昨晚翻了我的柜子。
lines.en: Someone searched my chest last night.
I brought a crate of new bottles.
Gold for potions; open for business.
Standing here for the first customer.
Sparks land on my snout, hot.
I fell off the brewing stand.
Water tastes strange; I cough.
The bench blew; every bottle broke.
An arrow stuck in my potion jar.
This curse turned my recipe bitter.
Brewing on an empty stomach was foolish.
Lightning struck; all my bottles jumped.
Falling, I only recall the recipe.
